records.editorial_note: Editorial clarification from the original diagram: consecutive circles are tangent, rather than all three circles pairwise tangent as the Spanish text claims. The smallest and largest circles are separated by the middle one in the printed figure. The bank follows that illustrated configuration. This clarified statement does not receive an exact-source check.

Editorial correction: the official PDF starts the right-hand sum at 1/1011. The correct start is 1/1001. Separating the harmonic sum into its even and odd terms proves the correction; the printed formula omits ten positive terms. The corrected statement does not receive an exact-source check.

Editorial clarification: S must be nonempty. The official sheet says every subset, but the empty subset gives zero points for every team and contradicts the stated odd-total hypothesis. The clarified statement does not receive an exact-source check.

Unresolved source domain gap: the official sheet says only a <= 2025 and does not specify the domains of a and k or a lower bound for a. The bank preserves that wording without adding an unconfirmed target range. If arbitrarily negative integer targets are allowed, no finite uniform move bound is possible. Organizer clarification is needed; this statement receives no exact-source badge.
